newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Banco Sotto rises on profit hopes.
newsitem.headline: Banco Sotto rises on profit hopes.

text.p: Shares in Banco Pinto & Sotto Mayor (BPSM) gained three percent on Monday with investors betting on good first half results, traders said.

Banco Pinto is one of the few leading banks still to publish profit figures for the first half of the year. Traders said that the Champalimaud group banks, which also include Banco Totta & Acores and Credito Predial Portugues should present their results on Tuesday.
The stock was up 2.8 percent at 1,912, off an earlier 1,925 high, with traders saying it could target its previous high for the year of 1.955 escudos reached on July 9.
"I expect the bank to show a good performance in the first half as happened with other banks," said one analyst.
"And the outlook for the second half is also good," he added.
Banco Sotto posted a first half profit of 2.83 billion escudos in 1996 and a full year result of 11.97 billion.
